text: Hmm, yeah, I don't think that's gonna work for me right now. I really don't have the order ID handy. Is there any other way you can just give me the price and battery life of the speaker from my order? Maybe if you could just tell me the info directly?
zh: 嗯，是的，我现在觉得这行不通。我真的没有方便的订单号。您还有其他方法可以直接告诉我我的订单中音箱的价格和电池寿命吗？也许如果您能直接告诉我这些信息就好了？
